title: Biophilic Kitchen Pavilion Configurator
description: The user designs a sunlit open-air kitchen pavilion by placing decorative avocado sculptures on countertops and shelves within a god-ray-illuminated architectural space. Users click to place avocados, adjust their scale and rotation, toggle volumetric light intensity, and validate the final arrangement meets minimum placement and spacing rules before exporting the design.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a Biophilic Kitchen Pavilion Configurator. Load godrays_demo.glb as the main architectural pavilion environment, centered at the origin and scaled so it fills roughly 80% of the viewport. Load Avocado.glb as a decorative sculptural element that can be cloned and placed by the user. Set up a PerspectiveCamera at position (5, 4, 8) looking at the origin with OrbitControls for navigation. Add an AmbientLight (intensity 0.3) and a DirectionalLight (intensity 1.2) from upper-left to simulate sunlight streaming through the pavilion. Implement a raycaster so that when the user clicks on any mesh surface of the godrays_demo model, a cloned Avocado instance is placed at the hit point, oriented to the surface normal. Each placed avocado should be selectable by clicking it, highlighting it with an emissive outline. Provide an HTML overlay panel with: (1) a slider to scale the selected avocado from 0.5x to 3.0x, (2) a rotation slider from 0 to 360 degrees around the Y-axis, (3) a button to delete the selected avocado, (4) a slider controlling the DirectionalLight intensity from 0.1 to 3.0 to simulate god-ray brightness changes, (5) a Validate Design button that checks the arrangement has at least 4 avocados placed, no two avocados are closer than 0.3 world units apart, and at least one avocado is above Y=1.5 (elevated shelf placement), displaying pass/fail status with specific error messages in a status bar. Keep a counter showing total placed avocados. Use GLTFLoader for both assets. Ensure all interactions update in real-time and the scene renders with antialiasing enabled and a soft gradient sky background using scene.background set to a light warm color.
